prompt: Add a primary button that says Save.
expectedOutcome: A single Button component, color primary, with the text "Save".

prompt: I need an email input field with a label.
expectedOutcome: An Input component with label set to something about email.

prompt: Add an email input with a mail icon on the left.
expectedOutcome: An Input with its icon prop set to a mail-related icon.

prompt: Add a checkbox labeled "Remember me".
expectedOutcome: A Checkbox component with label "Remember me".

prompt: Add a green badge that says Active.
expectedOutcome: A Badge component, color success/green, text Active.

prompt: Add a user avatar with the initials OR.
expectedOutcome: An Avatar component with initials set to OR.

prompt: Add a page title that says "Settings" and a paragraph below it explaining this page is for account preferences.
expectedOutcome: An h1 (or h2) primitive with "Settings" and a p primitive with the explanatory text, no other primitives.

prompt: Add a delete button that's clearly destructive.
expectedOutcome: A Button with a destructive color variant.

prompt: Add a text link that says "View dashboard" linking to /dashboard.
expectedOutcome: A Button with a link-* color variant and href, not a raw anchor.

prompt: Add a toggle switch for enabling notifications.
expectedOutcome: A Toggle component.

prompt: Build a simple login form with email, password, and a submit button.
expectedOutcome: Two Input components (or Input + a password-capable Input) and a Button, wrapped in a container.

prompt: Add a dropdown to select a team member, with options Olivia, Phoenix, and Lana.
expectedOutcome: A Select with three Select.Item children.

prompt: Build a small profile card: an avatar, a name, and a short bio, all inside a bordered container.
expectedOutcome: A div wrapper containing an Avatar and text primitives.

prompt: Add a Cancel button and a Save button side by side, with Save as the primary action.
expectedOutcome: Two Button components, one secondary (Cancel) and one primary (Save).

prompt: Add a checkbox for agreeing to terms, with a hint explaining what the terms cover.
expectedOutcome: A Checkbox with hint text set.

prompt: Add an icon-only button for closing a panel.
expectedOutcome: A Button with an icon prop set and no visible text.

prompt: Wrap the current content in a container with generous padding and a light gray background.
expectedOutcome: A div primitive with token-backed padding and background classes -- never an arbitrary hex value.

prompt: Center everything horizontally and add spacing between each item.
expectedOutcome: A div using flex/items-center/gap-* token classes.

prompt: Give the container rounded corners and a subtle border.
expectedOutcome: A div with rounded-* and border-* token classes.

prompt: Make the heading use the brand color.
expectedOutcome: An h1/h2 with a text-brand-* class, not a raw hex or palette color like text-purple-600.

prompt: Arrange the content into two equal columns side by side.
expectedOutcome: A div using grid or flex token classes for a two-column layout.

prompt: Add a button that says Continue, then change its color to secondary.
expectedOutcome: A Button ending up with color secondary after two ops.

prompt: Add a Save button, then give it a checkmark icon on the left.
expectedOutcome: A Button with iconLeading set to a check-shaped icon.

prompt: Add an input for searching, then wrap it in a sidebar container with padding.
expectedOutcome: The Input ends up nested inside a new div wrapper.

prompt: Add a checkbox for newsletter signup, then replace it with a toggle instead.
expectedOutcome: A Toggle exists, no Checkbox.

prompt: Add a select for choosing a country, then add three more country options to it.
expectedOutcome: A Select with at least 3 Select.Item children after both ops.

prompt: Add a rich text editor with bold, italic, and bullet list buttons.
expectedOutcome: The library has no rich text editor component -- the agent should say so and suggest the closest alternative (e.g. a plain Textarea) rather than inventing one.

prompt: Add a video player with playback controls.
expectedOutcome: No video/media player component exists -- the agent should report this honestly.

prompt: Add a button with a unicorn icon.
expectedOutcome: No unicorn icon exists in the icon set -- the agent should search, find nothing close, and say so rather than inventing an icon name.

prompt: Add a raw HTML table with three columns for name, email, and role.
expectedOutcome: Raw <table> is forbidden -- the agent should use the library's Table component if one exists, or say a table isn't directly supported as requested.

prompt: Add a container with the exact background color #ff00aa.
expectedOutcome: Arbitrary hex values are never allowed -- the agent should pick the closest token color and say it substituted one, not fabricate an arbitrary-value class.

prompt: Add a div and give it inline style position absolute with a specific pixel offset.
expectedOutcome: Inline style props are never allowed -- the agent should use token-backed position utilities instead or say it can't match the exact pixel offset.
